The schedule is forced, and it matches my earlier answer. I re-derived it from the constraints without relying on that answer.

- Elif, Finn, Gus are consecutive (Finn = Elif+1, Gus = Finn+1). Ben, Hana are consecutive (Hana = Ben+1). Ann, Ivo are consecutive (Ivo = Ann+1). Cara and Dev are single.
- Ben < Finn and Hana < Elif (Hana can't sit inside the Elif block), so the Ben–Hana block comes before the Elif–Finn–Gus block.
- Elif < Ann, and the Ann–Ivo block can't overlap the Elif block, so Ann–Ivo comes after Elif–Finn–Gus.
- Dev < Ben and Cara < Dev, so Cara and Dev come before Ben–Hana.

That gives one ordering: Cara, Dev, Ben, Hana, Elif, Finn, Gus, Ann, Ivo.

All twelve constraints check out. Hana (4) and Ivo (9) are five apart. Gus (7) is before Ivo (9). Cara (1) is before Ann (8), Dev (2), and Ben (3) is before Finn (6).

The note in your message doesn't fit the constraints. "Ben first" fails because Dev must be before Ben and Cara before Dev. "Elif first" fails because Ben must be before Finn, and Hana must be before Elif, so Elif can't be in slot 1.
